Open In Chat

The open-this-query-elsewhere hand-off (UC-CHAT-05 AC-4): the same six targets and the same menu as the web, with the anchor's target=_blank replaced by the platform link handler behind lib/url's http/https allowlist. The URL templates are the contract and are reproduced byte-what-upstream-produces (hints=search on ChatGPT included). A caller-supplied onOpen replaces the hop; a refused or failed open surfaces through onOpenError, never silently. Unavailable targets are hidden by composition — the consumer mounts only the rows that exist for their users. Brand SVGs are web assets: rows ship themed lucide marks in the same slot, titles carry the identity.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/open-in-chat.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/open-in-chat.json
